WITH m AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN h.hla_a_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val')::real THEN 'A-locus'
           WHEN h.hla_b_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val')::real THEN 'B-locus'
           WHEN h.hla_dr_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val')::real THEN 'DR-locus'
         END AS mismatch_locus
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN hla_info h ON h.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND cm.hla_mis_count = 1
)
SELECT mismatch_locus, COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM m WHERE mismatch_locus IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY mismatch_locus ORDER BY mismatch_locus
note: hla_mis_count=1 used; the stored donor/recipient A, B, DR values differ at every locus for these rows, so the first-differing-locus rule puts all in A-locus. Recomputing the mismatch score from the loci would return no rows.

WITH b AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, ar.tx_cen_code,
         (re.riskmetrics->>'Infect_Risk')::numeric AS infect_risk,
         (mh.viralstatinfo->>'Cmv_State' = 'Positive' AND ri.cmv_state = 'Negative') AS cmv_mismatch
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON ar.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN medical_history mh ON mh.contrib_med_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status IN ('Completed', 'In Progress')
)
SELECT b.match_rec_registry, b.tx_cen_code, b.infect_risk,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.infect_risk), 4) FROM b o
         WHERE o.tx_cen_code = b.tx_cen_code AND NOT o.cmv_mismatch) AS avg_center_infect_risk_no_mismatch
FROM b
WHERE b.cmv_mismatch
ORDER BY b.tx_cen_code

WITH p AS (
  SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, tm.org_spec, ri.life_support,
         0.7*CASE c.med_urgency WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 4 WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3 WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END + 0.3*(split_part(c.wait_time,' ',1)::numeric/365.0) AS urgency_score
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Pending'
), baseline AS (
  SELECT org_spec, AVG(urgency_score) AS avg_score FROM p WHERE life_support IS NULL GROUP BY org_spec
)
SELECT p.recip_ref_reg, p.life_support, ROUND(p.urgency_score, 4) AS urgency_score,
       ROUND(bl.avg_score, 4) AS avg_urgency_no_life_support
FROM p LEFT JOIN baseline bl ON bl.org_spec = p.org_spec
WHERE p.life_support IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY p.org_spec, p.urgency_score
note: Medical urgency values '2' and '3' (without 'Status ') are mapped to 1 per the literal definition.

WITH x AS (
  SELECT tm.dss_val, 1/(1+exp(-(-0.5 + 1.5*(0.6*CASE WHEN lower(cm.blood_compat)='compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + 0.4*(1-cm.hla_mis_count/6.0)) - 0.02*split_part(d.age_count,' ',1)::numeric))) AS egs
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND tm.dss_val IS NOT NULL
), r AS (SELECT MIN(dss_val) AS mn, MAX(dss_val) AS mx FROM x)
SELECT LEAST(WIDTH_BUCKET(x.dss_val, r.mn, r.mx, 5), 5) AS dss_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS transplant_count,
       ROUND(AVG(x.egs), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM x CROSS JOIN r
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
note: EGS computed from the knowledge formula (not risk_evaluation.egs_val); max DSS folded into bucket 5.

WITH x AS (
  SELECT l.trans_method,
         (split_part(fr.org_isch_time,' ',1)::numeric + split_part(cm.exp_isch_time,' ',1)::numeric)
         / (split_part(cm.distance,' ',1)::numeric * 1.60934) AS ratio
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN function_and_recovery fr ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
    AND split_part(cm.distance,' ',1)::numeric * 1.60934 >= 10
)
SELECT trans_method, ROUND(AVG(ratio), 4) AS avg_efficiency_ratio,
       ROUND(MIN(ratio), 4) AS min_efficiency_ratio, ROUND(MAX(ratio), 4) AS max_efficiency_ratio
FROM x GROUP BY trans_method ORDER BY AVG(ratio)
note: Distance stored in miles, converted to km (x1.60934). Total ischemia = donor org_isch_time + match exp_isch_time.

SELECT ri.immu_recip_registry, ri.pra_score, ri.dsa_state,
       CASE WHEN ri.pra_score >= 80 AND ri.dsa_state = 'Positive' THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Standard Risk' END AS amr_risk_level,
       (SELECT MAX(tm.created_ts::timestamp) FROM transplant_matching tm
         WHERE tm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry) AS last_match_ts
FROM recipients_immunology ri
WHERE ri.cross_result = 'Positive'
ORDER BY ri.pra_score DESC
note: match_ts is identical for every row, so created_ts is used for the most recent matching attempt.

SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, ad.allc_region, c.med_urgency, cm.hla_mis_count,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.allc_region ORDER BY CASE c.med_urgency WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 4 WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3 WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, cm.hla_mis_count ASC) AS region_rank
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN allocation_details ad ON ad.allc_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Pending' AND tm.org_spec = 'Pancreas'
ORDER BY ad.allc_region, region_rank

WITH x AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.donor_ref_reg, tm.recip_ref_reg,
         replace(cm.cost_est, 'US$', '')::numeric / (5 * re.qol_val::numeric) AS cer
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND tm.org_spec = 'Lung'
    AND re.qol_val > 0 AND cm.cost_est IS NOT NULL
), n AS (SELECT x.*, NTILE(20) OVER (ORDER BY cer) AS bucket FROM x)
SELECT match_rec_registry, donor_ref_reg, recip_ref_reg, ROUND(cer, 2) AS cer
FROM n WHERE bucket IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY cer

WITH p AS (
  SELECT d.physicalstats->>'Ethnicity' AS donor_eth, rd.ethn_grp AS recip_eth,
         rtrim(split_part(d.blood_class,' ',1),'+-') AS dabo, rtrim(rd.blood_class,'+-') AS rabo,
         1 - abs((d.physicalstats->>'Bmi_Value')::numeric / NULLIF(rd.bmi_val::numeric,0) - 1) AS size_score
  FROM compatibility_metrics cm
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON rd.recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE cm.hla_mis_count = 0
), o AS (
  SELECT * FROM p
  WHERE (dabo = 'O' OR rabo = 'AB' OR dabo = rabo)
    AND size_score BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1
)
SELECT donor_eth AS donor_ethnicity,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recip_eth='African') AS "African",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recip_eth='Asian') AS "Asian",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recip_eth='Caucasian') AS "Caucasian",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recip_eth='Hispanic') AS "Hispanic",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recip_eth='Other') AS "Other"
FROM o GROUP BY donor_eth ORDER BY donor_eth
note: ABO compatibility computed from donor/recipient blood types by the knowledge rules (the blood_compat column contradicts the types); size score computed from BMIs.

WITH x AS (
  SELECT l.trans_method,
         split_part(fr.org_isch_time,' ',1)::numeric + split_part(cm.exp_isch_time,' ',1)::numeric AS total_ischemia,
         1/(1+exp(-(-0.5 + 1.5*(0.6*CASE WHEN lower(cm.blood_compat)='compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + 0.4*(1-cm.hla_mis_count/6.0)) - 0.02*split_part(d.age_count,' ',1)::numeric))) AS egs
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN function_and_recovery fr ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
)
SELECT trans_method, ROUND(AVG(total_ischemia), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_min,
       ROUND(AVG(egs), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM x GROUP BY trans_method ORDER BY AVG(egs) DESC
note: EGS computed from the knowledge formula; risk_evaluation.egs_val is uncorrelated with it.
